## Problem

`packages/frontend/data/drummerComparisons.js:1645` already states Bill Ward's cymbals correctly as **Zildjian Avedis Series** (14" Hi-Hats, 16"/18" Crashes, 20" Ride, 18" China) — fixed by prior issues #6488/#7420/#5929. The sibling mirror directory `public/llms/vs/bill-ward-vs-charlie-benante.md` is also already correct (confirmed lines 14, 22, 37, 56 say "Zildjian Avedis Series").

However, a **separate, never-synced mirror directory** — `public/llms/comparisons/` — still fabricates the old "Paiste 2002 & Giant Beat Series" cymbals in 3 files, all last touched by PR #4260 (2026-07-10), which predates every one of the Zildjian-correction fixes above:

1. `/home/runner/work/MetalDrummerGear/MetalDrummerGear/public/llms/comparisons/bill-ward-vs-charlie-benante.md:25` — "...and Paiste 2002 & Giant Beat Series cymbals (15" Giant Beat Hi-Hats, 18" & 20" 2002 Crashes, a massive 24" 2002 Ride, 18" 2002 China)..."
2. `/home/runner/work/MetalDrummerGear/MetalDrummerGear/public/llms/comparisons/bill-ward-vs-mario-duplantier.md:25` — "Bill Ward used Paiste 2002 & Giant Beat Series cymbals (15" Giant Beat Hi-Hats, 18" & 20" 2002 Crashes, a 24" 2002 Ride, 18" 2002 China)."
3. `/home/runner/work/MetalDrummerGear/MetalDrummerGear/public/llms/comparisons/bill-ward-vs-matt-greiner.md:25` — "Bill Ward used Paiste 2002 & Giant Beat Series cymbals (15" Giant Beat Hi-Hats, 18" & 20" 2002 Crashes, a 24" 2002 Ride, 18" 2002 China)."

This is the same "fixed source + comparisons.md, not per-pair mirrors" blind spot already named in issues #9889 (Brann Dailor) and #9879 (Art Cruz) — a `public/llms/comparisons/` directory that duplicates `public/llms/vs/` content but isn't regenerated by the same process.

## Ground truth

`packages/frontend/data/drummerComparisons.js:1645` — Zildjian Avedis Series (14" Hi-Hats, 16"/18" Crashes, 20" Ride, 18" China), played since 1971 per prior fixes (#6488/#5929).

## Fix

In all 3 files, replace the Bill Ward cymbal clause:
"Paiste 2002 & Giant Beat Series cymbals (15" Giant Beat Hi-Hats, 18" & 20" 2002 Crashes, a [24"/]massive 24" 2002 Ride, 18" 2002 China)"
→
"Zildjian Avedis Series cymbals (14" Hi-Hats, 16" & 18" Crashes, 20" Ride, 18" China)"

Preserve each file's exact surrounding sentence structure and the other drummer's gear clause untouched.

## Verify

1. `grep -rn "Paiste 2002\|Giant Beat" public/llms/comparisons/bill-ward-vs-charlie-benante.md public/llms/comparisons/bill-ward-vs-mario-duplantier.md public/llms/comparisons/bill-ward-vs-matt-greiner.md` → 0 matches.
2. `grep -rn "Zildjian Avedis" public/llms/comparisons/bill-ward-vs-charlie-benante.md public/llms/comparisons/bill-ward-vs-mario-duplantier.md public/llms/comparisons/bill-ward-vs-matt-greiner.md` → 1+ match each.
3. `grep -c "Bill Ward" public/llms/comparisons/*.md` to confirm no other Bill Ward mirror file in this directory still carries the fabrication (sweep beyond the 3 found).
4. Diff each file's Bill Ward cymbal clause against `drummerComparisons.js:1645` — zero contradiction.

## Done

All Bill Ward mentions in `public/llms/comparisons/*.md` state Zildjian Avedis Series cymbals; no "Paiste 2002"/"Giant Beat" fabrication remains anywhere in that directory.
title: SEO batch: Bill Ward cymbals still fabricated as 'Paiste 2002 & Giant Beat Series' in 3 public/llms/comparisons/ mirror files — source + public/llms/vs/ already fixed to Zildjian Avedis
